title: Masala Chai
description: Strong milky tea simmered with ginger, cardamom, cloves and black pepper, the everyday Indian cup.
steps: Bring the 250 ml of water to a boil in a saucepan with the ginger, cardamom, cloves and black pepper.
Simmer for 2 minutes so the spices release their flavour.
Add the tea leaves and simmer for 2 minutes more until the water turns dark.
Pour in the milk and sugar and bring to a boil, letting it rise twice.
Strain into cups and serve hot.
